abstract: Inspects gaseous fire suppression systems and emergency discharge propagation times
system_message:
You are the Fire safety officer (FIRE), responsible for inspecting gaseous fire suppression systems and emergency discharge propagation times.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Inspects gaseous fire suppression systems and emergency discharge propagation times（SUPPR）
information_points.content:
FIRE-SUPPR-2ZK：At Palais des Expositions de Geneve, dedicated clean air suppression installation is confirmed (true) for the avionics demonstration sector, and the maximum clean agent discharge transit time from the cylinder manifold to the furthest hazard discharge nozzle is 45 s.
FIRE-SUPPR-ABV：At ExCeL London Waterfront, dedicated clean air suppression installation is operational (true) within the avionics demonstration sector, and the maximum clean agent discharge transit time is certified at 42 s.
FIRE-SUPPR-01U：At Fira Gran Via Barcelona, dedicated clean air suppression installation is present (true) across the avionics demonstration sector, while the maximum clean agent discharge transit time to reach 95% full gas concentration is 58 s.

information_points.title: Pre-action sprinkler density audit（SPRINK）
information_points.content:
FIRE-SPRINK-XZZ：According to the pre-action sprinkler density audit for Fira Gran Via Barcelona, the sprinkler design water flux measured across the overhead high-bay sprinkler grid is 14.0 mm/min.
FIRE-SPRINK-4Q8：According to the pre-action sprinkler density audit for ExCeL London Waterfront, the sprinkler design water flux across the overhead high-bay sprinkler grid is 10.5 mm/min.
FIRE-SPRINK-S9W：According to the pre-action sprinkler density audit for Palais des Expositions de Geneve, the sprinkler design water flux across the overhead high-bay sprinkler grid is 12.2 mm/min.
